title: James Randi's spoon and watch trick in front of Svahn

tellings.quote: And he he bent his spoon in front of me.

plain: James Randi, the stage magician known for debunking psychics, bent a spoon right in front of Clas Svahn and did a trick with a watch, as Svahn tells it. Svahn, a Swedish UFO researcher with a huge archive, tells Michels he saw it himself. The point is that Randi could fake, by sleight of hand, feats others claimed as real powers.
